mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, w.name AS warehouse_name, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM wms_reservation r JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = r.warehouse_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = r.material_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by
mapper.select: WHERE r.source_type = #{sourceType} AND r.source_id = #{sourceId} AND r.qty > 0 ORDER BY r.id

SELECT m.id AS "materialId", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.qty - s.frozen_qty) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.material_id = m.id), 0) AS "available", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.qty) FROM wms_reservation r WHERE r.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND r.material_id = m.id AND r.qty > 0), 0) AS "reserved" FROM wms_material m WHERE m.id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_reservation SET qty = CASE WHEN qty > #{qty} THEN qty - #{qty} ELSE 0 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
